reply.emotion: warm and welcoming, reaching out to give someone a big hug
notes: Refers specifically to the limb from the shoulder to the hand.
Can also refer to the sleeve of a piece of clothing (la manga), though brazo is primarily the anatomical part.

senses.definition: Miembro del cuerpo que va desde el hombro hasta la mano.

examples.text: Me duele mucho el brazo derecho después de nadar.
examples.translation: My right arm hurts a lot after swimming.
examples.emotion: tired and wincing slightly while rubbing the sore muscle

senses.definition: Parte de una prenda de vestir que cubre esta extremidad.

examples.text: La camisa tiene el brazo muy largo.
examples.translation: The shirt has a very long sleeve.
examples.emotion: annoyed while holding up a sleeve that clearly doesn't fit right
